messages:
Ellen (Finance): Heads-up  automated reconciliation flagged duplicated GPU charge lines across projects for the same instance IDs between 04:10-05:20 UTC. Potential double-attribution to customer accounts. Need triage ASAP. :rotating_light:
Hugo (Eng-Platform): Whoa. Can you paste the excerpt?
Ellen (Finance): Snippet from billing export + internal ETL join:
```
instance_id | project_id     | usage_start           | cost  
gcp-inst-0a1 | sentinel-run    | 2026-09-02T04:12:00Z  | 4200.00
gcp-inst-0a1 | redwood-prod    | 2026-09-02T04:12:00Z  | 4200.00
aws-i-9f2     | sentinel-run    | 2026-09-02T04:45:00Z  | 3500.00
aws-i-9f2     | redwood-prod    | 2026-09-02T04:45:00Z  | 3500.00
```
Same instance IDs, same time windows, mirrored costs under two project_ids.
LedgerBot: Reconciliation job 2026-09-02-07:00 flagged a 2x attribution anomaly for GPU SKUs.
Samir (Eng-ML): That suggests our node-label-propagation ETL duplicated host-level and container-level lines when both had cost_center labels. We changed the extractor last week to include both tags for richer attribution; looks like we didn't dedupe on instance_id.
Renee (Product): If customers were billed twice, we need a customer credit plan and communication. Which customers are affected?
Ellen (Finance): Quick breakdown: two customer-facing projects tied to the same tenant mapping (tenant-88): 'sentinel-run' (sandbox) and 'redwood-prod' (prod replica). Current ledger shows tenant-88 charged ~ $16.8k extra. I've opened FIN-2026-920. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.local/browse/FIN-2026-920.
Hugo (Eng-Platform): Rolling back the extractor change now. I'll also add a de-dup key on instance_id + timestamp to the ETL to prevent this.
Samir (Eng-ML): Agree. Immediate mitigation: pause the reconciliation job that auto-posts charge allocations to customer invoices while we verify. I'll flip the flag for the reconcile-runner.
LedgerBot: Reconcile-runner paused (manual override by Samir) at 2026-09-02T08:05Z.
Ellen (Finance): Proposed remediation steps: (1) Snapshot raw provider lines to gs://finance/snapshots/fin-2026-920-1865009999.csv (2) Run a dedupe backfill in billing dataset to mark duplicated rows with note:reconciled-dup (3) Generate one-time customer credit memo for tenant-88 and adjust internal chargebacks (4) Harden ETL and add post-run anomaly alert.
Renee (Product): Product approves issuing a credit memo if customers were billed. Please draft external comms for support to send.
Hugo (Eng-Platform): I'll push the rollback and hotfix (dedupe by instance_id, provider, start_time) and add a post-ETL sanity check that flags >1 line with same instance_id in the same hour.
Samir (Eng-ML): After we deploy the fix I'll run a backfill SQL to tag duplicate rows:
```
UPDATE billing.lines
SET notes = ARRAY_CONCAT(COALESCE(notes, []), ['reconciled-dup'])
WHERE (instance_id, usage_start) IN (
  SELECT instance_id, usage_start
  FROM billing.lines
  GROUP BY instance_id, usage_start
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) > 1
);
```
Ellen (Finance): I'll prepare the credit memo template and internal journal entry for $16,800 to offset tenant-88. Will coordinate with Revenue Ops and Support.
LedgerBot: Note: retro tags/notes won't change cloud provider invoices; they'll adjust internal attribution only.
Renee (Product): Owner assignments: Ellen -> prepare credit memo + revenue ops coord; Hugo -> rollback ETL + deploy dedupe + post-check; Samir -> pause reconcile + run backfill; Support/Comms -> draft customer message. Target: EOD 2026-09-02.
Hugo (Eng-Platform): Hotfix deployed to staging; rolling to prod now. Will post PR link.
Samir (Eng-ML): Reconcile-runner remains paused until backfill completes.
Ellen (Finance): Snapshot saved to gs://finance/snapshots/fin-2026-920-1865009999.csv. I'll update FIN-2026-920 with invoice/credit draft when ready.
Renee (Product): Thanks team. Please cc me on the comms. :thumbsup:
Ellen (Finance): Closing loop: will post final ledger adjustments and close ticket once credits applied.
